job_title: .NET Software Developer - Deerfield Beach, FL Onsite
job_description:
Hello There,

My name is Himanshu Sharma, and I serve as the Recruitment Lead at Kanak-IT INC. I am reaching out to share an excellent career opportunity for the role of .NET Software Developer with our esteemed client. If you are interested then please share your updated resume at Himanshu01@kanakits.com .

Job Description

Position : .NET Software Developer
Location : Deerfield Beach, FL Onsite (local candidates only)

Duration : Long Term Contract

MOI : The interview process will include one internal round with my manager via Microsoft Teams (audio/video), followed by one or two rounds with the client. Please note, the client may also request an onsite interview.

Job Description
Azure Software Developer will be responsible for researching, designing, implementing, and writing code to develop software programs. The Senior Software Developer is accountable for building high-quality, high-performance, and high-availability applications using both Waterfall and Agile methodologies.
Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, debug, and troubleshoot software systems and components.
• Develop across multiple platforms: Azure, Python, Node.JS, .NET Core, .NET Framework, REST APIs, Microservices, CosmosDB, SQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Azure DevOps (ADO), and GitHub Enterprise (GHE).
• Write and execute unit tests for software projects.
• Collaborate closely with Solution Architects, DevOps Engineers, QA Engineers, Project Managers, Information Security Engineers, and Delivery Managers.
• Utilize GitHub Copilot (Enterprise) responsibly to enhance productivity, ensuring full ownership and validation of all generated code.

Additional Notes
• Azure Certified Software Developers / Azure Certified DevOps Engineers are strongly encouraged.
• Onsite presence is strongly preferred.
